photos.desc: Scarlet-chested Parrot ( Neophema splendida ) in Australia

An immature male Scarlet-chested Parrot at Gluepot Reserve, South Australia, Australia. Gluepot Reserve, which is a 54,000 hectare property owned by Birds Australia in Mallee country north of Waikerie
A male Scarlet-chested Parrot in Gluepot Reserve, South Australia, May 2023
